summary: Implementation and regression coverage match the saved plan: pre-merge settle emits structured started/completed logs to structlog and monitor.log with workspace id, PR number, base branch, repo URL, full head SHA, wait seconds, and elapsed seconds; _terminate_completed persists a provided merge SHA onto an already-completed workspace with null pr_merge_sha while preserving stale-callback audit behavior; the added tests use the repository's real PostgreSQL fixture. Existing validation evidence is current with the implementation commit and reports the focused regressions, broader runtime monitor tests, ruff, mypy, and full coverage gate passing at 99.02%.
